dialogue.origin: こんにちはよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Hello, it's nice to meet you.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。こちらこそよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Hello. It's nice to meet you too.

dialogue.origin: 少し早いですが、始めてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: We're a little early, but would it be alright if we begin?

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫ですよ。
dialogue.content: That's fine.

dialogue.origin: それでは始めます
dialogue.content: Alright then, let's begin.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor.

dialogue.origin: 相談にきていただきありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.origin: 今日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.content: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: なんか生きててもつまらないです。
dialogue.content: I just feel like life is boring.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どんなところからそうお感じですか？
dialogue.content: What makes you feel that way?

dialogue.origin: 学校も楽しくないし
dialogue.content: School isn't fun,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 両親は忙しくて私の事見てないし
dialogue.content: and my parents are busy and don't pay attention to me,

dialogue.origin: 特にやりたいこともないからですかね
dialogue.content: and I guess it's because there's nothing in particular I want to do.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 楽しいことも、やりたいこともないとそんな風に感じるのも無理ないのかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: If there's nothing enjoyable and nothing you want to do, it makes sense that you would feel that way.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに、あなたの年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: By the way, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 16歳　女子です
dialogue.content: I'm a 16-year-old girl.

dialogue.origin: 教えてくださりありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you for telling me.

dialogue.origin: 高校2年生でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Are you a sophomore in high school?

dialogue.origin: 1年です
dialogue.content: I'm a freshman.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 学校ではどんな感じ過ごしていますか？
dialogue.content: How do you usually spend your time at school?

dialogue.origin: どんな感じ…別に普通です
dialogue.content: How do I spend my time... Nothing special, just normally.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: お友達とかはいかがですか？
dialogue.content: What about friends?

dialogue.origin: 友達いないんで、基本一人で過ごしてます
dialogue.content: I don't have any friends, so I'm usually by myself.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: お友達がいないと寂しいのかなと思ったのですが、どうお感じですか？
dialogue.content: I wondered if not having friends might feel lonely—how does that feel for you?

dialogue.origin: うーん
dialogue.content: Hmm.

dialogue.origin: 中学から似たような感じなので、もう慣れました
dialogue.content: It's been like this since middle school, so I'm used to it now.

dialogue.origin: 慣れていらしゃるのですね
dialogue.content: So you've gotten used to it.

dialogue.origin: 休み時間とかはどうされていますか？
dialogue.content: What do you usually do during breaks?

dialogue.origin: 人があんまりいない図書館とかにいます
dialogue.content: I stay in places like the library, where there aren't many people.

dialogue.origin: (図書館→図書室です。すみません。)
dialogue.content: (I said library, but I meant the school library. Sorry.)

dialogue.origin: 図書室だと落ち着きますよね
dialogue.content: The school library can be a calming place, can't it?

dialogue.origin: あまり人と関わりたくないので、そこにいると楽です
dialogue.content: I don't really want to interact with people, so it's more comfortable for me there.

dialogue.origin: 気を使わなくて済みますよね
dialogue.content: You don't have to worry about what other people think, right?

dialogue.origin: 読書とかはされているのですか？
dialogue.content: Do you do any reading while you're there?

dialogue.origin: そうですね本を読んでます
dialogue.content: Yes, I read books.

dialogue.origin: どんな本が好きですか？ジャンルとか作家とか
dialogue.content: What kind of books do you like? Any particular genres or authors?

dialogue.origin: ミステリーをよく読みます
dialogue.content: I often read mysteries.

dialogue.origin: 推理するのがお好きなんですね
dialogue.content: It sounds like you enjoy trying to solve them.

dialogue.origin: まあ、そんな感じです
dialogue.content: Well, something like that.

dialogue.origin: 本を読んでいる時は少しは楽しかったりするのかなって思ったのですが
dialogue.content: I was wondering if you feel at least a little enjoyment when you're reading.

dialogue.origin: 周りと関わらなくていいので、楽ではありますでも、やることないから読んでるって感じです
dialogue.content: It's comfortable because I don't have to interact with others, but it feels more like I'm just reading because there's nothing else to do.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: だから、別に生きててもしょうがないかなって思います
dialogue.content: So, I think maybe there's no point in living.

dialogue.origin: そう思うと切ないですね
dialogue.content: That sounds heartbreaking.

dialogue.origin: 切ないっていうか、なんか、諦めてます
dialogue.content: It's not so much heartbreaking... it's more like, I've given up.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: いつ頃からそう思うようになったのですか？
dialogue.content: When did you start to feel that way?

dialogue.origin: 中学のころから感じてはいました
dialogue.content: I've been feeling this way since middle school.

dialogue.origin: 中学のころから諦観されていたのですか・・・
dialogue.content: So you've had this sense of resignation since middle school...

dialogue.origin: 高校に入って強くなった感じがします
dialogue.content: I feel like it's gotten stronger since I started high school.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: あなたのお話を伺って、
dialogue.content: From what you've shared,

dialogue.origin: 学校生活で楽しいことがなく、両親も忙しくてあなたのことを見てくれず、
dialogue.content: it sounds like there's nothing enjoyable in your school life, and your parents are busy and don't really pay attention to you,

dialogue.origin: やりたいこともなく手、生きていてもつまらなく感じていることがとても伝わってきました
dialogue.content: and without anything you want to do, it has come across very clearly that you feel life is boring.

dialogue.origin: そして諦めさえも感じていらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.content: And on top of all that, you're even feeling a sense of resignation.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 諦めてはいても、やはり生きる楽しさを感じられないことは、苦しいのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Even if you've resigned yourself to it, isn't it still painful not to be able to feel any joy in life?

dialogue.origin: そうですね楽しくないから、つまらなくて嫌になります
dialogue.content: Yes, because it's not fun, it becomes boring and unpleasant.

dialogue.origin: でも、どうしようもないし仕方ないかなって思います
dialogue.content: But I feel like there's nothing I can do, so it can't be helped.

dialogue.origin: そう思うとやるせないですよね
dialogue.content: That must feel so helpless.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes, it is.

dialogue.origin: どんなことができたら楽しくなれると思われますか？
dialogue.content: What kinds of things do you think might make life feel more enjoyable?

dialogue.origin: うーん
dialogue.content: Hmm...

dialogue.origin: 分かりません
dialogue.content: I don't know.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: それが思い浮かばないほど、いろいろなことが嫌になってしまっているのかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: Perhaps you've grown so weary of everything that you can't even think of anything.

dialogue.origin: 周りの人は友達出来たら、とか言うかもしれないけど一人でいる方が楽だし
dialogue.content: People around me might say things like, "You should make some friends," but it's more comfortable for me to be alone, and...

dialogue.origin: そうかもしれないです
dialogue.content: That might be true.

dialogue.origin: 一人でいる方が楽ならそれでいいですよね
dialogue.content: If being alone is more comfortable for you, then that's perfectly fine.

dialogue.origin: いいんですかね周りは変なやつだって思わないですかね
dialogue.content: Is that really okay? Won't people around me think I'm weird?

dialogue.origin: 世の中にはいろいろな人がいますからね
dialogue.content: Well, it takes all kinds of people to make a world.

dialogue.origin: 周りの人の目とかは気になりますか？
dialogue.content: Do you worry about what other people think?

dialogue.origin: そうですかね
dialogue.content: I guess so.

dialogue.origin: まあ、多少は気になります何か言われても嫌だし
dialogue.content: Well, I do worry about it a little. I wouldn't like it if people said things about me.

dialogue.origin: すみませんそろそろ親の手伝いしなくちゃいけないので、失礼します
dialogue.content: I'm sorry, I have to go help my parents soon, so I should get going.

dialogue.origin: 了解しました
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: それでは終了します
dialogue.content: Then we'll end the session here.

dialogue.origin: とても勉強になりました辛口のコメントを待っています今日はありがとうございました
dialogue.content: This was a great learning experience. I'm looking forward to your candid feedback. Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.origin: （お疲れさまでした！難しい設定ですみません…。勉強になりました。ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.content: (Good work! Sorry for the difficult scenario... It was a great learning experience for me too. Thank you.)

dialogue.origin: それでは失礼します
dialogue.content: Then I'll be going. Goodbye.

dialogue.origin: （はい、失礼いたします。）
dialogue.content: (Yes, goodbye.)

topic.sub: 友達がいないことによる孤独感
